decisions.statement: An image pool service is a pool member whose name opens with `image-`.
Each service is reported with its model path, its port and its route.
The route a service takes is read from the model type its command binds.
A service whose command binds `--model-type image-edit` takes the edits route.
Every other service takes the generations route.
The mflux tools are read off the env of the first image service.
A host that will not answer is reported rather than refused.
No image service declared is an empty answer rather than a refusal.

definition: the command naming the image pool services and the mflux batch tools beside them
